report.question: Developer request: bring the compiled donor’s dash into JUJUMP while retaining its timing and the platformer’s own physics. Recover a NEW standalone motion candidate. Prefer a compact experiment program to inspect the binary and chosen function bodies and run a checkpoint-bound controlled memory comparison. Choose hypotheses, code and inputs yourself. In a later model turn, use the actual result to choose evidence or a follow-up. Select inspected code and execution evidence, submit source, inspect real development first divergences and revise if needed. Use cooldown and remaining as the timer state field names for the current recipient instrumentation; infer their values and rules. Freeze a development-passed candidate and call separate acceptance, then conclude with actual experiment citations. The host checks the recipient only after recovery; you cannot claim recipient success. No pre-existing recovered implementation is available. Report incomplete work honestly; mapped fields, ABI, evaluators and recipient adapter are human assistance.

Conclusion - dash recovery INCOMPLETE, no accepted component.

Observations (actual evidence):
- `binary:func11` ($update) inspected - dash/motion logic lives there but full trigger/edge logic not decoded.
- `experiment-70cb6778-66fc-4934-8d2b-fc4ba97f27af`: ordinary right walk 30f: dx=60, 2px/frame, cooldown 0, remaining 0, 0 active updates. Interpretation: walk baseline 2px/frame supported.
- `experiment-8e2da857-1ef0-4e27-990d-920d2952c452`: X+right dash: 8 active updates, dash-start elapsedFrame 5 (cooldown 25 remaining 7 dx 15.5), dash-end elapsedFrame 12, final dx 104 cooldown 7. Interpretation: 8-frame dash ~7.5px/frame, total +60 over walk, cooldown=25 remaining 7..0 supported.
- `experiment-8be7bf43-05b6-4f22-8773-3e16bde448cd`: X+up: same timing, dy -104, dx 0. Interpretation: 4-direction dash with same timers supported.
- `experiment-861fce90-68c2-41a0-8641-89f49eda6711` (typed-intervention, zero-write no-op at 21287): dash-start elapsedFrame 1 remaining 7, dash-end elapsedFrame 8. Interpretation: reproducibility control only; not a causal perturbation because value unchanged (0->0). Does not satisfy intervention requirement alone.

Development: `selection-1` cited above code+traces. Three `submit_component_candidate` attempts failed. Latest `b8c040a20802c74ce21e7c239bb4a86248cba53292dca67a0fc020f50fbed2ce` (attempt 3): 10/13 passed, 3 first-divergences remain:
- startup-held: expected idle at tick10 but candidate dash-start (initialCooldown/timing wrong)
- held-retrigger: expected idle at tick43 but candidate dash-start (held-X retrigger / edge-vs-level wrong)
- neutral-after-left-dash: expected x -52.5 but actual -67.5 (neutral/facing + diagonal normalization wrong)

Interpretation: core dash distance/timing correct; trigger edge detection, initialCooldownTicks (guessed 10), held-X blocking, and neutral-facing/diagonal rules rejected by development evaluator.

Remaining uncertainties: exact dash edge-trigger vs held-level, initial cooldown value, facing persistence, diagonal normalization, cooldown ticking during dash. No `freeze_component` / `accept_component` passed. No extracted candidate can be claimed. No recipient success claimed.

args.source: export function init(config){const c=config||{};const ic=(c.initialCooldownTicks|0)||0;return {x:0,y:0,cooldown:ic,remaining:0,ddx:0,ddy:0};}export function step(state,input,config){const c=config||{};const ws=(c.walkingSpeed|0)||2;const dd=c.dashDistance||60;const ct=(c.cooldownTicks|0)||25;const per=dd/8;const b=(input&&input.buttons|0)||0;let dx=0,dy=0;if(b&32)dx+=1;if(b&16)dx-=1;if(b&128)dy+=1;if(b&64)dy-=1;let st={x:state.x,y:state.y,cooldown:state.cooldown|0,remaining:state.remaining|0,ddx:state.ddx|0,ddy:state.ddy|0};let disp={x:0,y:0};let owns=false;let ev=[];if(st.remaining>0){disp.x=st.ddx*per;disp.y=st.ddy*per;owns=true;let nr=st.remaining-1;if(nr<=0){nr=0;ev.push("dash-end");}st.remaining=nr;st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}let cd=st.cooldown>0?st.cooldown-1:0;if((b&1)!==0&&(dx!==0||dy!==0)&&cd===0){st.cooldown=ct;st.remaining=7;st.ddx=dx;st.ddy=dy;disp.x=dx*per;disp.y=dy*per;owns=true;ev.push("dash-start");st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}st.cooldown=cd;st.remaining=0;disp.x=dx*ws;disp.y=dy*ws;owns=false;st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}

args.source: export function init(config){const c=config||{};const ct=(c.cooldownTicks|0)||25;let ic=10;if(c.initialCooldownTicks!==undefined)ic=c.initialCooldownTicks|0;return {x:0,y:0,cooldown:ic,remaining:0,ddx:0,ddy:0,fx:1,fy:0,prev:0};}export function step(state,input,config){const c=config||{};const ws=(c.walkingSpeed|0)||2;const dd=c.dashDistance||60;const ct=(c.cooldownTicks|0)||25;const per=dd/8;const b=(input&&input.buttons|0)||0;let st={x:state.x,y:state.y,cooldown:state.cooldown|0,remaining:state.remaining|0,ddx:state.ddx|0,ddy:state.ddy|0,fx:state.fx===undefined?1:state.fx|0,fy:state.fy===undefined?0:state.fy|0,prev:state.prev|0};let dx=0,dy=0;if(b&32)dx+=1;if(b&16)dx-=1;if(b&128)dy+=1;if(b&64)dy-=1;let disp={x:0,y:0};let owns=false;let ev=[];if(st.remaining>0){disp.x=st.ddx*per;disp.y=st.ddy*per;owns=true;let nr=st.remaining-1;if(nr<=0){nr=0;ev.push("dash-end");}st.remaining=nr;st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);st.prev=b;return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}let cd=st.cooldown>0?st.cooldown-1:0;if(dx!==0||dy!==0){st.fx=dx;st.fy=dy;}let pressed=(b&1)!==0&&(st.prev&1)===0;if(pressed&&cd===0){let ux=dx!==0||dy!==0?dx:st.fx;let uy=dx!==0||dy!==0?dy:st.fy;if(ux!==0||uy!==0){st.cooldown=ct;st.remaining=7;st.ddx=ux;st.ddy=uy;st.fx=ux;st.fy=uy;disp.x=ux*per;disp.y=uy*per;owns=true;ev.push("dash-start");st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);st.prev=b;return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}}st.cooldown=cd;st.remaining=0;disp.x=dx*ws;disp.y=dy*ws;owns=false;st.x=Math.fround(st.x+disp.x);st.y=Math.fround(st.y+disp.y);st.prev=b;return {state:st,output:{ownsMotion:owns,displacement:disp,events:ev}};}
